card.name: Range dash after days in onset times
card.fires_on: The dash or word "to" joining the low and high ends of a day range, right after the first number. It appears in parentheses after a median time to onset in days.

modes.label: Range in days after median
modes.description: The dash or "to" between the two ends of a range after a median time in days.
modes.example: The median time to first occurrence was 8 days (range 1<< to>> 519).

modes.label: Spacing of days between doses
modes.description: The gap before a day range in a dosing interval.

card.writes: It pushes toward calendar and time-span words such as months and calendar, and away from weekly and week.
card.plain: It marks the spot between the two numbers of a day range, as in a time-to-onset of 1 to 350 days.
